kol.take: agent 价值正在从一次性生成转向长期工作流；状态管理、成本归因、工具调用和反馈闭环会决定 token 消耗与产品粘性。
kol.take_en: Agent value is moving from one-shot generation to durable workflows; state, cost attribution, tool use and feedback loops drive token usage and stickiness.
kol.take_zh: Vercel 的设计系统文档被用作代理工作流中的单一指令文件，团队借助评估框架约束输出风格，并把线上反馈循环接入代理以持续校准品牌一致性。
kol.detail: Our agents use 𝚟𝚎𝚛𝚌𝚎𝚕​.𝚌𝚘𝚖/𝚍𝚎𝚜𝚒𝚐𝚗​.𝚖𝚍 to build on-brand pages. ▪︎ One file encodes decisions and guidance ▪︎ Output is shaped through our eval harness ▪︎ Production feedback is fed back into the loop
kol.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 说明，其团队的代理利用 vercel.com/design.md 这一单一文件来构建品牌一致的网页。该文件内含决策与指引，输出经过评估 harness（eval harness）塑形，而生产反馈则被循环回注以持续优化工作流。

kol.take: 模型商业化要看真实路由和 $ spend 份额，而不是只看 benchmark；渠道份额能更早暴露谁在生产流量里变现。
kol.take_en: Model monetization is better tracked through real routing and $ spend share than benchmarks; channel share reveals who is monetizing production traffic.
kol.take_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出企业将编程 Token 视同无限制 AWS 密钥，允许从 3.8 美元/月到 4 万美元/月实例随意调用，缺乏治理。AI Gateway 新增按密钥及按用户预算控制，防止资源滥用。
kol.detail: Coding tokens are basically infrastructure. Yet, the way companies have approached them amounts to: "Hey all, here's an AWS key. It can spin up anything from a 𝚝𝟹.𝚗𝚊𝚗𝚘 (＄𝟹.𝟾𝟶/𝚖𝚘) to an 𝚙𝟻.𝟺𝟾𝚡𝚕𝚊𝚛𝚐𝚎 (＄𝟺𝟶𝚔/𝚖𝚘). Go wild" And obviously the reason companies don't do this for their core infra is that you need to govern, optimize, and observe usage and costs. The intern might decide to host a static website in that 192 vCPU machine, and you won't be very happy about the bill. AI Gateway fixes this for all your tokens, with per-key, and now per-user budgets.
kol.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出，编程 Token 实为基础设施，但企业管理却如发放无限制 AWS 密钥，允许从低成本到月费 4 万美元实例随意调用，严重缺乏治理与成本观测。他强调 AI Gateway 解决此痛点，新增按密钥及按用户预算控制，防止资源滥用如用昂贵实例托管静态网站。

kol.take: 模型能力仍受底层计算效率与供给约束；硬件、系统软件和推理优化共同决定可交付的速度与成本。
kol.take_en: Model economics still depend on compute efficiency and supply; hardware, systems software and inference optimization jointly determine speed and cost.
kol.take_zh: NVIDIA 与 MediaTek 深化合作，MediaTek 采用 NVLink Fusion 技术，让客户可将自研 XPU 无缝接入 NVIDIA 机架级 AI 基础设施，加速定制芯片从设计到量产落地。
kol.detail: We’re excited to expand our work with @MediaTek. 🤝 AI factories will be built around differentiated compute — but custom silicon needs a path from chip design to production-scale systems. With MediaTek adopting NVIDIA NVLink Fusion, customers can focus on what makes their XPUs unique and connect them to NVIDIA rack-scale AI infrastructure.
kol.detail_zh: NVIDIA 宣布将与 MediaTek 深化合作，共同推动 AI 工厂围绕差异化算力构建。MediaTek 采用 NVIDIA NVLink Fusion 技术，使客户能够专注于自身 XPU 的独特设计，并将其无缝接入 NVIDIA 机架规模的 AI 基础设施。这一合作旨在为定制芯片提供从设计到大规模生产的完整路径，加速 AI 基础设施的落地。

David and Gavin explore the possibility that frontier labs, open-source models, applications, clouds, and NVIDIA can all capture significant value as AI adoption expands. kol_archive.detail: Two days ago JFrog dropped CVE-2026-82329, a critical authentication bypass in Artifactory. It’s a CVSS 9.8, a disastrous vulnerability score. It’s like a 9.8 earthquake on the seismic scale. It affects default configs, requires no auth, no user interaction. It’s an RCE bomb because Artifactory hosts binaries, so you can basically poison everything, but an admin escalation can cause damage even beyond that. When the OpenAI / Hugging Face news came out of agents discovering zero-days, I was wondering if it was marketing-speak or reality, because I hadn’t seen a CVE filing. Now it’s here: I don’...
kol_archive.detail_zh: JFrog 近日披露 CVE‑2026‑82329，这是 Artifactory 默认配置存在的严重身份绕过漏洞，CVSS 得分 9.8，无需身份验证且无用户交互即可触发远程代码执行，可用于投毒二进制甚至提升管理员权限造成更大破坏。此前 OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 报告称 AI 代理能发现零日漏洞曾被质疑为营销言论，而现在该 CVE 的出现证明了其真实性。

kol_archive.detail: Ben Horowitz, Martin Casado, Raghu Raghuram, and Erik Torenberg discuss the launch of a16z's new Machine Age Fund and the infrastructure buildout behind AI, from chips, memory, and networking to power, cooling, and data centers. Why a dedicated fund now? The group argues that the bottleneck in AI is increasingly shifting from the models themselves to everything beneath them. Hyperscaler CapEx is surging, critical components are booked years in advance, and each new generation of reasoning and agents requires dramatically more compute. They unpack why this cycle looks different from previous in...
kol_archive.detail_zh: a16z 创始合伙人 Ben Horowitz、Martin Casado、Raghu Raghuram 和 Erik Torenberg 宣布成立全新 Machine Age 基金，专注投资 AI 基础设施全链条，从芯片、内存、网络到电力、散热和数据中心。他们认为 AI 的瓶颈正从模型层转向底层硬件，超大规模云厂商资本支出激增，关键元器件已被提前数年预订，每一代推理与智能体所需算力呈指数级增长。因此该基金旨在抓住这一周期与以往不同的投资机遇。

kol_archive.detail: AI Gateway can now call webhooks after long generations 😍 ① Lower compute costs (no long-running process waiting idly) ② More reliable. Gateway can take more of the processing burden ③ You can 𝚊𝚠𝚊𝚒𝚝 𝚑𝚘𝚘𝚔() in "𝚞𝚜𝚎 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔𝚏𝚕𝚘𝚠" to sanely consume these
kol_archive.detail_zh: AI Gateway 新增在长时间生成结束后触发 webhook 的功能，既能避免长时间闲置的计算开销，又提升了可靠性，使网关能够承担更多处理负荷。用户可在 “use workflow” 中通过 await hook() 合理消费这些回调，从而实现资源利用的更高效。

kol_archive.take: agent 越能自主改代码，底层 runtime 越需要确定性、隔离与恢复能力；更快的生成速度反而提高了工程约束的重要性。
kol_archive.take_en: As agents gain autonomy over code, runtimes need more determinism, isolation and recovery; faster generation raises the value of engineering constraints.
kol_archive.take_zh: Run SDK 推出安全 eval 功能，可在轻量 QuickJS 环境中直接执行智能体生成的代码，既无需完整沙箱，也带来更快的运行速度和更低的成本。
kol_archive.detail: We're introducing Run SDK: secure 𝚎𝚟𝚊𝚕 for dynamic Code Mode execution. When agents write code, you don't always need a full sandbox. You can 𝚛𝚞𝚗 their code in a lightweight QuickJS secure context. Faster and more cost-efficient. 𝚗𝚙𝚖 𝚒 𝚛𝚞𝚗
kol_archive.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 在 X 上宣布推出 Run SDK，为动态 Code Mode 执行提供安全的 eval 功能。该方案采用轻量级 QuickJS 安全上下文运行代理生成的代码，无需完整沙箱，因而更快且成本更低。开发者可通过 npm 安装指令 `npm i run` 直接使用。

kol_archive.detail: My guest today is Neil Movva, founder of Sail. Sail is building what Neil calls a token factory, an inference company designed for a specific kind of future, one where AI agents run in the background for hours or days at a time rather than answering a human in real time. In that world, latency matters less and cost matters more, and Neil has built the whole company around driving the cost of a token as low as it can possibly go. What makes this conversation special is that it is one of the most detailed tours I have ever done through the full stack of intelligence, the software, the chips, and...

Models are able to do coding-adjacent engineering work better than I can: debugging, profiling, optimizing, bug fixing, system design, abstraction design, ui design, idea generation, etc. 3. kol_archive.detail: PJM overpaid $12 billion across two capacity auctions, and the same modeling error is set to repeat in an upcoming emergency auction. Robert Boswall (@RobertBoswall) and Jordan Nanos (@JordanNanos) break down how the largest grid in America, 13 states and 66 million people, inflates demand while constraining supply. The result is scarcity pricing that ratepayers absorb, not the data centers driving the narrative. Of the $63 billion spent across four auctions, Boswell estimates $12 billion was avoidable, split $7 billion and $5 billion across the 2025-26 and 2026-27 auctions. This is the mechan...
kol_archive.detail_zh: PJM 在两次容量拍卖中多付了 120 亿美元，同样的建模错误将在即将到来的紧急拍卖中重复出现。罗伯特·博斯沃尔和乔丹·纳诺斯指出，覆盖 13 个州、6600 万人的美国最大电网通过虚高需求、限制供应导致稀缺定价，费用由用户承担而非推动叙事的数据中心。在四次拍卖共花费的 630 亿美元中，博斯沃尔估计可避免的损失达 120 亿美元，其中 2025‑26 年度拍卖占 70 亿美元，2026‑27 年度拍卖占 50 亿美元。

kol_archive.detail: Thoughts About Scaling Law Scaling, but not only of parameters. Every model release now ends with the same question: how many parameters? It isn't a question that can be answered on its own. Parameter count is only meaningful alongside three others — how much data you have, where you intend to spend your compute, and who will run the model, under what conditions. The field learned this the hard way. Kaplan et al. (2020) fit an exponent that told everyone to grow parameters faster than data — roughly 2.7:1 — and the industry complied: GPT-3, Gopher, MT-NLG. Hoffmann et al. (2022) redid the expe...
kol_archive.detail_zh: 模型规模的评估不应仅关注参数量，而应综合考虑数据规模、计算资源投入以及推理环境。过去行业过度追逐参数增长（如 Kaplan 研究中建议参数与数据比例为 2.7:1），导致了 GPT-3 等模型过度堆砌参数，而 Hoffmann 等人的后续研究修正了这一认知，强调了计算效率与数据质量在 Scaling Law 中的核心地位。

kol_archive.take_zh: Vercel Labs 开源了基于 Zig 编写的原生编程智能体 fx。该工具通过单二进制文件实现极速响应，冷启动仅需 10 微秒，且基准内存占用仅为个位数 MB，旨在为编程智能体提供高性能的集成与基准测试环境。
kol_archive.detail: Introducing fx, a tiny, open, native coding agent from Vercel Labs. Originally an internal tool, fx is a harness and CLI written in Zig, optimized for research and embedding in larger systems. Today, we're open sourcing it. fx is built on three principles: 1. Fast. A single native binary, no runtime to install. It cold starts in 10µs and does no unnecessary work or I/O before accepting input. fx is the answer to "how fast can a coding agent be?" 2. Light. The 6.3MiB binary uses single-digit megabytes of memory at baseline, made for instant installation and embedding in resource-constrained env...
kol_archive.detail_zh: Vercel Labs 开源了原生编程智能体 fx。该工具采用 Zig 编写，以单二进制文件形式提供，具有极高的性能，冷启动仅需 10 微秒，且内存占用极低（基准仅需个位数 MB）。fx 设计理念强调极速与轻量化，旨在作为研究工具或集成组件嵌入到更大的系统中，为“编程智能体的响应速度上限”提供新方案。

kol_archive.detail: My guest today is Ben Thompson, the founder and author of Stratechery. Ben is one of my favorite business thinkers and I love talking to him about everything happening in markets and technology. We go through every important company, including OpenAI, Nvidia, Intel, Apple, Microsoft, Google, and Amazon. We also discuss why he thinks it would be dangerous for the United States to win the AI race outright, what container shipping and the railroads of the 1870s tell us about the buildout, and why the binding constraint on all of this may be capital rather than compute. Please enjoy my conversatio...
kol_archive.detail_zh: Ben Thompson 在访谈中深入探讨了 AI 产业布局，分析了 OpenAI、Nvidia、Intel、Apple、Microsoft、Google 及 Amazon 等核心科技巨头的地位。他提出，当前的 AI 建设逻辑类似于 19 世纪 70 年代的铁路或集装箱航运业，并指出制约当前 AI 发展的核心瓶颈可能在于资本投入，而非单纯的算力资源。此外，他还探讨了美国在 AI 竞赛中完全获胜可能带来的潜在风险。

kol_archive.take: agent 越能自主改代码，底层 runtime 越需要确定性、隔离与恢复能力；更快的生成速度反而提高了工程约束的重要性。
kol_archive.take_en: As agents gain autonomy over code, runtimes need more determinism, isolation and recovery; faster generation raises the value of engineering constraints.
kol_archive.take_zh: Vercel 现已针对沙盒环境发起百万美元黑客挑战赛，旨在通过测试防火墙边界来应对 Agent 潜在的越权漏洞，参赛者最高可获得五万美元的单份漏洞报告奖励。
kol_archive.detail: Agents can now exploit vulnerable sandbox boundaries, so we are testing ours in the open. $1,000,000 hacker challenge for Vercel Sandbox: • Escape the Firecracker microVM • Defeat the host-side network boundary • Up to $50k/report via @Hacker0x01
kol_archive.detail_zh: Vercel 宣布针对其 Sandbox 沙盒环境发起金额高达 100 万美元的黑客挑战赛。该项目旨在应对 Agent 可能会利用沙盒边界漏洞进行攻击的风险，重点测试是否能突破 Firecracker 微型虚拟机并攻破宿主侧的网络边界。获胜者通过 HackerOne 提交报告，最高可获得单笔 5 万美元的奖励。

kol_archive.take_zh: Guillermo Rauch 建议企业应采用单体仓库模式构建软件工厂，将设计、营销、销售及工程等所有业务上下文整合在统一平台中，以便为 AI 智能体提供完整的构建基础。
kol_archive.detail: Your software factory should be a monorepo. All your company context (design, marketing, sales, engineering, support…) in one place for agents to build upon
kol_archive.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 建议将软件工厂构建为单体仓库（monorepo）模式，旨在将设计、营销、销售、工程和支持等所有公司上下文信息整合在统一的平台中。这种结构化做法的核心价值在于为 AI Agent 提供完整的业务知识库，使其能够基于全方位的公司数据进行构建与协作。
